title: 成语谚语 · Chinese Proverbs
subtitle: 22 Chinese proverbs & sayings with example sentences

items.zh: 树大招风
items.py: shù dà zhāo fēng
items.en: A prominent person attracts trouble (lit. a tall tree catches the wind)

items.zh: 入乡随俗
items.py: rù xiāng suí sú
items.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do (lit. enter village, follow customs)

items.zh: 一分价钱一分货
items.py: yì fēn jià qián yì fēn huò
items.en: You get what you pay for

items.zh: 塞翁失马
items.py: sài wēng shī mǎ
items.en: A loss may turn out to be a gain (lit. the old man lost his horse)

items.zh: 画蛇添足
items.py: huà shé tiān zú
items.en: Ruin something by overdoing it (lit. draw a snake and add feet)

items.zh: 对牛弹琴
items.py: duì niú tán qín
items.en: Speak to the wrong audience (lit. play the lute to a cow)

items.zh: 爱屋及乌
items.py: ài wū jí wū
items.en: Love everything about someone (lit. love the house and its crows)

items.zh: 井底之蛙
items.py: jǐng dǐ zhī wā
items.en: A person with a limited view (lit. a frog at the bottom of a well)

items.zh: 三思而后行
items.py: sān sī ér hòu xíng
items.en: Think before acting (lit. think three times, then act)

items.zh: 有志者事竟成
items.py: yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng
items.en: Where there is a will, there is a way

items.zh: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃
items.py: zǎo qǐ de niǎo ér yǒu chóng chī
items.en: The early bird catches the worm

items.zh: 熟能生巧
items.py: shú néng shēng qiǎo
items.en: Practice makes perfect (lit. familiarity breeds skill)

items.zh: 冰冻三尺，非一日之寒
items.py: bīng dòng sān chǐ, fēi yī rì zhī hán
items.en: Problems take time to develop (lit. three feet of ice is not formed in a single day)

items.zh: 一石二鸟
items.py: yī shí èr niǎo
items.en: Kill two birds with one stone

items.zh: 百闻不如一见
items.py: bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
items.en: Seeing is believing (lit. hearing 100 times is not as good as seeing once)

items.zh: 亡羊补牢
items.py: wáng yáng bǔ láo
items.en: Better late than never (lit. mend the pen after losing sheep)

items.zh: 知足常乐
items.py: zhī zú cháng lè
items.en: Contentment brings happiness

items.zh: 一举两得
items.py: yī jǔ liǎng dé
items.en: Achieve two goals at once (lit. one action, two gains)

items.zh: 失败是成功之母
items.py: shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ
items.en: Failure is the mother of success

items.zh: 时间就是金钱
items.py: shí jiān jiù shì jīn qián
items.en: Time is money

items.zh: 说曹操，曹操到
items.py: shuō Cáo Cāo, Cáo Cāo dào
items.en: Speak of the devil (lit. speak of Cao Cao and Cao Cao arrives)

items.zh: 有钱能使鬼推磨
items.py: yǒu qián néng shǐ guǐ tuī mò
items.en: Money makes things happen (lit. money can make ghosts push a millstone)

items.zh: 他现在很有名，但树大招风。
items.py: Tā xiànzài hěn yǒumíng, dàn shù dà zhāo fēng.
items.en: He is very famous now, but a tall tree catches the wind.

items.zh: 在中国生活，要入乡随俗。
items.py: Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó, yào rù xiāng suí sú.
items.en: Living in China, you should do as the locals do.

items.zh: 这个很贵，但一分价钱一分货。
items.py: Zhège hěn guì, dàn yì fēn jià qián yì fēn huò.
items.en: This is expensive, but you get what you pay for.

items.zh: 这次失败，也许是塞翁失马。
items.py: Zhè cì shībài, yěxǔ shì sài wēng shī mǎ.
items.en: This failure might turn out to be a blessing in disguise.

items.zh: 不要再改了，会画蛇添足。
items.py: Bú yào zài gǎi le, huì huà shé tiān zú.
items.en: Don't change it any more, you'll ruin it by overdoing it.

items.zh: 跟他解释太难，就像对牛弹琴。
items.py: Gēn tā jiěshì tài nán, jiù xiàng duì niú tán qín.
items.en: Explaining to him is too difficult, it's like playing the lute to a cow.

items.zh: 我喜欢他，也爱屋及乌喜欢他的朋友。
items.py: Wǒ xǐhuan tā, yě ài wū jí wū xǐhuan tā de péngyou.
items.en: I like him, and by extension also like his friends.

items.zh: 不学习新东西，会变成井底之蛙。
items.py: Bù xuéxí xīn dōngxi, huì biànchéng jǐng dǐ zhī wā.
items.en: If you don't learn new things, you'll become a frog in a well.

items.zh: 做决定前要三思而后行。
items.py: Zuò juédìng qián yào sān sī ér hòu xíng.
items.en: Before making a decision, think it through carefully.

items.zh: 努力学习，有志者事竟成。
items.py: Nǔlì xuéxí, yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng.
items.en: Study hard — where there is a will, there is a way.

items.zh: 如果你想成功，就要努力，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
items.py: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng chénggōng, jiù yào nǔlì, zǎo qǐ de niǎo ér yǒu chóng chī.
items.en: If you want to succeed, you must work hard — the early bird catches the worm.

items.zh: 汉语说得不好没关系，熟能生巧。
items.py: Hànyǔ shuō de bù hǎo méi guānxi, shú néng shēng qiǎo.
items.en: It doesn't matter if your Chinese isn't good yet — practice makes perfect.

items.zh: 他的压力不是一天来的，冰冻三尺，非一日之寒。
items.py: Tā de yālì bú shì yī tiān lái de, bīng dòng sān chǐ, fēi yī rì zhī hán.
items.en: His stress didn't come overnight — Rome wasn't built in a day.

items.zh: 这次旅行既学习又放松，真是一石二鸟。
items.py: Zhè cì lǚxíng jì xuéxí yòu fàngsōng, zhēn shì yī shí èr niǎo.
items.en: This trip combines studying and relaxing — truly killing two birds with one stone.

items.zh: 你自己去看看吧，百闻不如一见。
items.py: Nǐ zìjǐ qù kànkan ba, bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn.
items.en: Go see for yourself — seeing is believing.

items.zh: 现在开始学习也不晚，亡羊补牢。
items.py: Xiànzài kāishǐ xuéxí yě bù wǎn, wáng yáng bǔ láo.
items.en: It's not too late to start studying now — better late than never.

items.zh: 他生活简单，但知足常乐。
items.py: Tā shēnghuó jiǎndān, dàn zhī zú cháng lè.
items.en: His life is simple, but contentment brings happiness.

items.zh: 运动可以减肥又健康，一举两得。
items.py: Yùndòng kěyǐ jiǎnféi yòu jiànkāng, yī jǔ liǎng dé.
items.en: Exercise helps you lose weight and stay healthy — two goals at once.

items.zh: 不要怕失败，失败是成功之母。
items.py: Bú yào pà shībài, shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ.
items.en: Don't be afraid of failure — failure is the mother of success.

items.zh: 我们要珍惜时间，时间就是金钱。
items.py: Wǒmen yào zhēnxī shíjiān, shí jiān jiù shì jīn qián.
items.en: We should treasure time — time is money.

items.zh: 我们刚说他，他就来了，真是说曹操，曹操到。
items.py: Wǒmen gāng shuō tā, tā jiù lái le, zhēn shì shuō Cáo Cāo, Cáo Cāo dào.
items.en: We just mentioned him and he showed up — speak of the devil!

items.zh: 在有些地方，有钱能使鬼推磨。
items.py: Zài yǒuxiē dìfang, yǒu qián néng shǐ guǐ tuī mò.
items.en: In some places, money can make anything happen.
